From: Dr. Elena Morales <emorales@stateuniv.edu>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request for academic credits & 3-month trial extension — Morales Lab

Hi Marissa,

I lead the Morales Lab at State University (computational linguistics / digital archives). We're starting a NSF-funded project that will use Redwood Inference for large-scale evaluation of model-generated annotations on historical texts. Our formal project start is next month and the grant will cover paid usage after an initial trial.

Before the award paperwork is processed we wanted to request:
- A promotional research credit (we estimate $5,000 USD of token usage over 3 months)
- A 90-day trial extension on the hosted API so our students can complete baseline experiments

Attached: IRB_certificate.pdf and a short letter of support from our Sponsored Research Office. If helpful I can also provide a brief scope doc and a budget line item.

Key points:
- Non-profit, university research; results will be published under an open-access license where possible.
- We will not use the service for any commercial offering.

Could you advise next steps and any required institutional verification? We're on a tight timeline to run pilot evaluations in mid-March.

Thanks,
Dr. Elena Morales
Associate Professor, Morales Lab
State University

(555) 612-2241
